boxes.meaning: independent, able to manage on your own

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for being independent, including an independent candidate.
This is the all-purpose choice for a person, especially a child, who can act without relying on or being controlled by others.

examples.english: My son now knows how to take the bus home by himself; he is really autonomous.
examples.traditional: 個仔而家識自己搭巴士返屋企，真係好獨立。

english.note: Use this when separate emphasizes being a standalone or independently functioning unit, rather than merely being apart.

examples.english: This flat has a separate kitchen, so you don’t have to share one.
examples.traditional: 呢間屋有獨立廚房，唔使同人共用。
